title: oldenlandia chrysotricha
intro: Oldenlandia chrysotricha, commonly known as yellow hairstem, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Asia, for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, contribute to its medicinal properties.
